chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The shroud is torn when the deceased is placed into his grave, from the side of his head.

key_terms.الْكَفَنُ: the burial shroud of the deceased

ai.seo_question: How should the kafan be handled when the deceased is placed in the grave?
ai.summary: This hadith states a funerary ruling concerning the deceased at the time of burial. It instructs that the shroud should be torn from the side of the head when the dead person is placed into the grave.
